01 · About

About Dr. Tapan Ghose

Dr. Tapan Ghose is listed as a cardiologist in New Delhi, with 30+ years of experience published by the source reviewed for this profile. The listing is grouped within electrophysiology and heart rhythm care.

A specialty label or total years in practice does not establish suitability for a particular patient. The diagnosis, symptoms, test results, proposed treatment, hospital resources and relevant clinical team must be assessed together.

Published specialty, city and experience were reviewed from the cited directory profile. Current hospital appointment, medical registration, clinical role and availability are reconfirmed before a referral.

04 · Care pathway

The doctor’s role in cardiac care

Cardiac care can involve clinical cardiologists, imaging specialists, interventional cardiologists, electrophysiologists, anaesthesia, intensive care and cardiac or vascular surgeons.

✓ Review the diagnosis, imaging and suitability for the proposed procedure
✓ Explain non-procedural and procedural alternatives
✓ Coordinate anaesthesia, imaging, intensive-care or surgical backup where needed
✓ Discuss material risks, devices, recovery and warning signs
✓ Define medicines and follow-up responsibilities

No appointment is assumed from an older directory entry. TIB HIND asks the hospital to confirm the doctor, campus and relevant team before travel or payment.

06 · Questions to ask

Questions for the doctor and hospital

01What is your current role and hospital appointment?
02Which tests are required before a treatment decision?
03What alternatives should be compared with the proposed procedure?
04Who performs the procedure and manages complications?
05Which hospital resources and backup teams are required?
06How will medicines and follow-up be managed after travel?
07 · International patients

Consultation and travel planning

Before travel, request the clinical opinion available from the records, tests likely to be repeated, proposed hospital, expected admission pathway, indicative estimate and follow-up plan. Final decisions are made after the responsible clinical team completes its assessment.

Emergency warning: sudden or persistent chest pain, severe breathlessness, fainting, new weakness or confusion may require urgent local care. Do not delay emergency assessment to arrange international travel.

We are a facilitator, not a hospital

TIB HIND does not provide medical treatment, diagnosis or emergency care. All treatment is delivered by independent, accredited hospitals and their consultants, who remain solely responsible for clinical decisions.

Costs are ranges, not quotations

Published figures are indicative ranges based on recent cases. Your final cost is set by the treating hospital after clinical assessment and can change if your treatment does.

Your medical records

Reports you send are reviewed by our medical team and are not shared with any hospital without your instruction. See our privacy and data protection policy.

This site is not for emergencies

If you have chest pain, stroke symptoms, severe bleeding or any acute deterioration, contact your local emergency services now. Do not wait for a reply from us.
